intent: Resolve remaining diagnostic findings and the supplied 120-check audit review: typed MCP authentication/local validation and protocol diagnostics, actionable repair navigation and honest fresh execution evidence, plus remaining GitHub diagnostic routing and current-head validation.
task_store: The existing engineering Room task store requires the installed Android application. This versioned development checkpoint records repository work without fabricating runtime receipts.
preservation: Preserve all concurrent repairs through starting_head; reconcile remote head before publication.
Refresh OAuth only once for a confirmed HTTP 401; retain 403 and uncertain mutation outcomes without replay.
Keep configuration, fixtures, discovery, execution and device evidence distinct; optional absence is not failure.
Never claim affected MCP targets repaired without fresh exact-configuration discovery and authorized execution evidence.
Do not store private audit contents, credentials, unrestricted responses or connection names in the repository.

github_continuity_and_narrator.scope: Actual production Kotlin source with explicitly inventoried host Android/provider boundaries; not Android or live GitHub acceptance.

validation.current_head_android: Required on the final published source tree. No local Android SDK/device or affected private-service access; ancestor checks do not qualify these changes.

mcp.scope: Actual MCP manager, transports, OAuth, validation, diagnostics and revision helpers; explicit Android/persistence/telemetry host boundaries. Three full resolver wiring regressions require Android CI.

audit_core.scope: Actual audit models, catalog, runner, lifecycle, plugin source, export, qualification and pure presentation; explicit host dependencies. No live execution inferred.

audit_services.scope: Entire AppAuditPluginServicesTest class against current audit, MCP revision/presentation and gateway route sources with explicit HTTP-client/Android host boundaries. Reproduced two behavior regressions corrected; four initial host-boundary failures resolved without production changes.
